# Based on pseudobulk (binarized)
```{r}
## Define variables and files
binarized_cutoff <- 0.5
ref_pseudobulk <- read.table("~/Scratch_MF/2026_Falis_et_al/ReferenceFiles/Pseudobulks/MouseCompleteAtlas_AveragePseudobulk_ByCellType_26thMay2026.txt")
age_est <- read.table("~/Scratch_MF/MolecularEvolutionAnalysis_July2026/age_of_transcriptome/Data/ReferenceFiles/MouseAtlas_AgeOfTranscriptomeInfo_PCG.txt")
pcg_list <- readRDS("~/Scratch_MF/2026_Falis_et_al/ReferenceFiles/GeneLists/PCGs/Mouse_GRCM39_PCG.rds")


## Define function
calculateTAI <- function(x) {
  tai = sum(age * x) / sum(x)
  tai
}

## Processing age of transcriptome
age_est_noNaN <- age_est %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(Age_Adj) == FALSE)
age_NaN <- age_est %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(Age_Adj)) %>% pull(ensembl_gene_id)

## Processing pseudobulk to retain only PCGs
ref_pseudobulk[ref_pseudobulk < binarized_cutoff] <- 0
to_remove <- rownames(ref_pseudobulk[rowSums(ref_pseudobulk) == 0,])
ref_pseudobulk <- ref_pseudobulk[!(rownames(ref_pseudobulk) %in% to_remove),]
ref_pseudobulk <- ref_pseudobulk[rownames(ref_pseudobulk) %in% pcg_list,]
ref_pseudobulk[ref_pseudobulk >= binarized_cutoff] <- 1

## Merging
data <- ref_pseudobulk %>% 
  rownames_to_column("ensembl_gene_id") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(ensembl_gene_id %in% age_est_noNaN$ensembl_gene_id) %>%
  left_join(age_est_noNaN) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("ensembl_gene_id") %>%
  dplyr::select(Age_Adj, everything())
age <- data$Age_Adj

## Calculating and formatting
mouse_tai <- apply(data[,-1], 2, function(x) calculateTAI(x))
mouse_tai <- data.frame(cell.type = names(mouse_tai), TAI = mouse_tai, row.names = NULL)
mouse_tai <- mouse_tai %>%
  mutate(Class = case_when(cell.type %in% c("SpT", "STGC", "SynTI", "SynTII") ~ "Novel trophoblast",
                                                cell.type %in% c("precSTGC", "precSynTI") ~ "Novel trophoblast precursors", 
                                                .default = "Other"))

## Plotting
p1 <- ggplot(data = mouse_tai, aes(x = reorder(cell.type, -TAI), y = TAI, fill = Class)) + 
  geom_point(size = 10, shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 1) + 
   theme(panel.background = element_blank(), 
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        text = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, angle = 37.5, hjust = 1, colour = "black"), 
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Novel trophoblast" = "#006400", "Novel trophoblast precursors" = "#7FBF7B", "Other" = "#E3D3B3")) + 
  ylab("Transcriptomic phylogenetic age 
       (binarized expression)")
p1

## Saving
ggsave(filename = paste0("Visuals/c_Mouse_TAI_PseudobulkBinarized_cut", binarized_cutoff, ".png"), plot = p1, width = 12, height = 10)
ggsave(filename = paste0("Visuals/c_Mouse_TAI_PseudobulkBinarized_cut", binarized_cutoff, ".pdf"), plot = p1, width = 12, height = 10)

## Clean up
rm(list = ls())
```
